test_description: Insufficient sample count — supply sparse 3-round histogram (sum=3 < W_min) and verify whether solver enforces a minimum sample count or overfits 3 noisy syndromes
input_contract: Minimum sample threshold W_min or prior-dominated hold when sum(hist) is ultra-sparse (N=3)
independent_oracle: With N=3 rounds (2 hits in bin 6), prior must either hold/reject sparse window or prevent extreme jump

expected.sparse_sample_behavior: Enforce W_min hold/fallback or prior-dominated bound on N=3 samples

actual.sparse_sample_behavior: No W_min check (total==0 only); converged=true, theta_(4)=0.450000

assertion_notes: DEFECT: HistogramLBFGSSolver::fit_histogram has no W_min minimum-sample guard (only checks `total == 0`); on just 3 rounds (hist[6]=2, hist[0]=1), it reports converged=true and swings theta_(4) from 0.012 to 0.450000!
